values.title: Build a Useful Component
values.text: A short guide from a clear contract to a working example.

values.title: The contract
values.text: Inputs are explicit. Outputs are predictable. Content stays separate from presentation.

values.title: Before you begin
values.text:
A project
A small use case
A way to test the result

## Quick start

1. Name the thing the component does.
2. Define the fields it needs.
3. Render a useful empty state.
4. Try representative content.
5. Keep the contract stable.

values.title: Review checklist
values.items:
Fields have clear names
Empty values render safely
Keyboard use works
Content survives an edit

values.text:
## Example fields

**title** — A short, meaningful heading.

**text** — The body content in plain text or supported Markdown.

**url** — An optional safe link.

Keep examples close to the rules they explain.
